frozen_candidate_root_contribution: A bounded body of people individuated within a larger whole by shared alignment/course/kind — a side, party, or faction, characteristically a proper part set off against other such bodies (and against the enemy). Valence is contextual, not lexical: it spans commended solidarity (Abraham of Noah's party 37:83; Moses' side 28:15) and condemned fragmentation (the sects produced by dividing religion 6:159, 30:32; imposed factionalism 28:4, 6:65). It does not entail kinship, contemporaneity, a living leader, or fixed polarity. The lone verbal token (24:19, indecency 'spreading/becoming current') is retained inside the same derivational family but is a semi-detached, singly-attested dynamic sense not independently bridged to the nominal nucleus Quran-internally.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: For 11 of 12 occurrences, ش ي ع names a distinguishable grouping of people held together by a common allegiance, course, or kind, and marked off from others — 'one's side/party' (شِيعَة), 'factions/sects' (شِيَعًا), or 'counterparts of the same kind' (أَشْيَاع). The word itself carries no fixed praise or blame; the surrounding context (siding with Moses vs. being made to fight; Abraham's righteous camp vs. religion split into rival sects) supplies the valence. One verb (تَشِيعَ, 24:19) means an abstract thing 'spreading' through people and denotes no group at all; it is kept in the same family but is the single case the nominal account cannot govern.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT mean: (1) a fixed 'heretical/religious sect' — valence and referent range from a street-fight side (28:15) to generic ancient communities (15:10, 19:69) to mere counterparts-in-kind (54:51); (2) 'unity' or an undivided whole — it marks a part presupposing other sides, and the plural is the very product of fragmentation (فَرَّقُوا 6:159, 30:32); (3) a physical co-present crowd — alignment can span generations (Abraham to Noah 37:83; prior أَشْيَاع 34:54, 54:51); (4) 'followers of a named living leader' — leadership is optional; N2 factions follow a shared دِين/course with none named; (5) 'spreading/diffusion' for the nouns — that sense is confined to the single verb (24:19) and is not derivable from the nominal forms. It is also distinct from طَآئِفَة (a portion/section, 28:4) and حِزْب (a bounded party-unit, 30:32): شِيعَة foregrounds partisan co-alignment.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 24:19:5:1 «أَن تَشِيعَ الْفَـحِشَةُ فِى الَّذِين ءَامَنُوا» — the lone verb. Its subject is an abstract act (الفَاحِشَة), not people; the sense is purely 'spread / become current' with zero grouping, party, or allegiance content. It resists any account built on 'faction/following' and can be salvaged only by retreating to an over-abstract 'coursing/propagation' nucleus resting on this single attestation — reasoning from morphology-family to sense, which the contract warns is not identity. Quran-internally the verb and the eleven nouns share no co-text, syntactic frame, or derivational demonstration (only a thin فِى-collective frame parallel), so the bridge is not independently established. This is the principal ceiling on confidence.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That ش ي ع is two unbridged classes — a nominal 'faction/aligned bloc/those-of-a-kind' (11 occ) and a verbal 'spread/become widespread' (24:19 alone) — linked only by the barred classical etymon 'follow/go-together → gather/spread'. This is rejected as the FINAL verdict for two reasons: (a) the nominal class is internally coherent, broad, and distinctive enough to warrant a positive PREFERRED nominal account rather than collapsing the whole root to UNRESOLVED; (b) a thin but genuine Quran-internal resonance (the shared 'فِى a collective' frame: تَشِيعَ فِى الَّذِين ءَامَنُوا vs فِى شِيَعِ الأَوَّلِين) keeps the verb inside one under-articulated derivational family. But because that bridge is not independently demonstrable, the verb is held as a resistant sub-class and strength is capped at MODERATE rather than STRONG — the competitor is not defeated so much as it forces the ceiling.

internal_discovery.rationale: The nominal account is broad (Suras 6, 15, 19, 28, 30, 34, 37, 54), distinctive (allegiance axis شِيعَة↔عَدُوّ at 28:15; marked against حِزْب 30:32 and طَآئِفَة 28:4; robust شِيَعًا↔فَرَّق partition regularity across 6:159/30:32/28:4/6:65), and adversarially clean within all 11 nominal cases. That alone trends toward STRONG. Two contract-mandated caps hold it at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE: (1) a genuinely resistant single-token verbal sub-class (24:19) whose bridge to the nominal nucleus is not Quran-internally demonstrable — 'morphology ≠ semantic identity'; (2) a cohesion-vs-fragmentation valence spread inside the nouns (commendable being-of-a-شِيعَة vs. blameworthy becoming-شِيَعًا) which, while unified as one valence-neutral 'aligned bloc' invariant, shows the nominal use is itself a family of related senses. Per the contract, a resistant sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. The result is honestly PREFERRED (the nominal nucleus is confidently characterized), not a failure; the nominal↔verbal unity is plausible-but-unproven.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Singular شِيعَة (with pronoun or after كل): 'one's own side / party / following' — a bloc defined by allegiance to a common course, individuated against others and against the enemy.
clusters.classification_rationale: 28:15 fixes the sense by direct opposition شِيعَتِهِ ↔ عَدُوِّهِ (his side vs. his enemy); 37:83 places Abraham 'of Noah's شِيعَة' across generations, so alignment/way — not contemporaneity or discipleship of a living leader; 19:69 'from every شِيعَة' individuates each grouping. Valence ranges neutral-to-commendable, showing it is contextual not lexical.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: شِيعَتِهِ→عَدُوِّهِ antonymy (28:15); cross-generational alignment (37:83); individuation مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ (19:69).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Plural شِيَع / شِيَعًا: 'factions / rival sects' — the same aligned-bloc notion in the plural, characteristically the product of division and mutual hostility.
clusters.classification_rationale: The plural collocates tightly with fragmentation: فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُم وَكَانُوا شِيَعًا (6:159, 30:32, the latter glossed by كُلُّ حِزْبٍ), جَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا (28:4, divide-and-rule, contrasted with طَآئِفَة), يَلْبِسَكُم شِيَعًا with mutual بَأس (6:65). 15:10 شِيَعِ الأَوَّلِين is the neutral plural 'groupings of the ancients'. Same 'aligned bloc' invariant; the condemnation comes from فَرَّق/بَأس, not from شِيعَة itself. A grouping here can be imposed, not voluntary.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: شِيَعًا↔فَرَّق partition pattern (6:159, 30:32); imposition جَعَل/يَلْبِس (28:4, 6:65); حِزْب and طَآئِفَة co-text distinguishing شِيعَة; neutral 15:10.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Broken plural أَشْيَاع: 'those of your/their same kind or persuasion' — predecessors on the same course who met a like fate.
clusters.classification_rationale: كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِن قَبْلُ (34:54) and أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُم (54:51) group by sameness-of-category across generations, confirming the core is shared course/kind, not a co-present entourage. Grouping-by-kind stretches the concrete 'organized party' reading slightly but is absorbed under the aligned-bloc invariant.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Cross-generational 'of your kind' both bound to مِن قَبْلُ / prior destruction (34:54, 54:51); confirms alignment, not contemporaneity.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Verb تَشِيعَ: '(of an abstract phenomenon) to spread / become current' through a population — no group, persons, or allegiance denoted.
clusters.classification_rationale: The sole verbal token; subject is الفَاحِشَة (an act), not people. It carries none of the nominal grouping content and is bridged to the nucleus only by an inferential, singly-attested 'coursing/propagation' abstraction and a thin فِى-collective frame parallel. Per 'same root ≠ one meaning' and 'morphology ≠ semantic identity', the bridge is not Quran-internally demonstrated; held as a resistant sub-class within the derivational family.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Only فِى-collective frame links it to the nouns (تَشِيعَ فِى الَّذِين ءَامَنُوا vs فِى شِيَعِ الأَوَّلِين); no shared co-text, no verse forms a شِيعَة by an act of تشيع.

reconciliation.rationale: Grouping-by-sameness-of-kind is absorbed under the valence-neutral 'aligned bloc / shared course' invariant (paralleled by 34:54); it does not denote spreading and shares the nominal grouping core, so it is retained as CONSISTENT within N3, not a resistant class.

adversarial_verification.notes: The nominal nucleus survives adversarial pressure across all 11 nominal occurrences with a distinctive allegiance/individuation load (28:15 antonymy; حِزْب/طَආئِفَة contrast). However one occurrence (24:19, verb) genuinely resists and its bridge is not independently establishable, so a clean SUPPORTED/PASSED verdict with empty failing_occurrences is not available; recorded as NOT_RUN with the resistant token logged rather than claimed PASSED.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: The sole verbal token; subject is الفَاحِشَة (an act), not people. It carries none of the nominal grouping content and is bridged to the nucleus only by an inferential, singly-attested 'coursing/propagation' abstraction and a thin فِى-collective frame parallel. Per 'same root ≠ one meaning' and 'morphology ≠ semantic identity', the bridge is not Quran-internally demonstrated; held as a resistant sub-class within the derivational family.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (bottom-up A, derivational-distinctiveness B, adversarial C) converged on the same nominal nucleus, the same single resistant verbal token, and the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE ceiling.
candidate_root_contribution: A bounded body of people individuated within a larger whole by shared alignment/course/kind — a side, party, or faction, characteristically a proper part set off against other such bodies (and against the enemy). Valence is contextual, not lexical: it spans commended solidarity (Abraham of Noah's party 37:83; Moses' side 28:15) and condemned fragmentation (the sects produced by dividing religion 6:159, 30:32; imposed factionalism 28:4, 6:65). It does not entail kinship, contemporaneity, a living leader, or fixed polarity. The lone verbal token (24:19, indecency 'spreading/becoming current') is retained inside the same derivational family but is a semi-detached, singly-attested dynamic sense not independently bridged to the nominal nucleus Quran-internally.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 12/12 confirmed occurrences read in full from the packet (11 nominal N, 1 verbal V); word_refs, qac_pos, and verse_text verified against the real packet.
layer_attribution.derivation: Morphology groups the data into singular شِيعَة (N1), sound plural شِيَع/شِيَعًا (N2), broken plural أَشْيَاع (N3), and one Form-I imperfect verb تَشِيعَ (V); morphology is used only to partition, not to assert semantic identity across the noun/verb boundary.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: The three nominal sub-forms share one valence-neutral invariant: an aligned bloc of people individuated within a larger whole (side/faction/those-of-a-kind). The verbal form is a segregated dynamic sense ('spread/become current') held as a resistant sub-class within the same derivational family.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Context supplies valence and referent (Moses' side vs. enemy; Abraham's righteous camp; religion split into rival sects; Pharaoh's divide-and-rule; abstract indecency spreading) but is NOT elevated into the root claim — the root itself remains valence-neutral 'aligned bloc', not 'sect' or 'schism'.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 54:51 (أَشْيَاعَكُم) was reconsidered from edge-uncertainty to CONSISTENT under the shared 'aligned bloc/kind' invariant; 24:19 (verb) was retained as RESISTANT after failing an internal bridge test, rather than forced into the nominal nucleus.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The verb 24:19 persists as an unbridged resistant seam: its 'spread/become current' sense is not Quran-internally demonstrated to share the nominal nucleus, capping result_strength at MODERATE and claim_scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_cases.reason: The only verbal token; abstract subject الفَاحِشَة 'spreading', no group/allegiance content. Its bridge to the 11-token nominal nucleus is not demonstrable Quran-internally (only a thin فِى-collective frame), so it caps strength at MODERATE and keeps scope REPRESENTATIVE.

evidence_basis.statement: 24:19:5:1 «أَن تَشِيعَ الْفَـحِشَةُ فِى الَّذِين ءَامَنُوا» — the lone verb. Its subject is an abstract act (الفَاحِشَة), not people; the sense is purely 'spread / become current' with zero grouping, party, or allegiance content.

hard_case_representation.rationale: One genuine resistant occurrence persists after reconciliation: the verb 24:19, whose 'spread/become current' sense is not Quran-internally bridged to the nominal 'aligned bloc' nucleus. The nominal account (11/12) is PREFERRED and clean; the single verbal token is carried as a resistant sub-class within the same derivational family rather than forced into unity.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A demonstration that the verb 24:19 (تَشِيعَ الفَاحِشَة) and the nominal 'aligned bloc/faction' sense are Quran-internally the same sense (single nucleus) — or, conversely, that the nominal occurrences do NOT share the 'aligned-bloc individuated within a whole' invariant and instead resolve into two or more unbridged nominal senses.
rejection_condition.search_location: The abstract-subject verbal frame at 24:19:5:1 against the nominal grouping frames (28:15 side-vs-enemy, 6:159/30:32/28:4/6:65 شِيَعًا↔فَرَّق, 34:54/54:51 أَشْيَاع), plus حِزْب/طَآئِفَة contrast co-text.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether any verse forms a شِيعَة by an act of تشيع or applies the grouping sense to the verb (or vice versa) without importing the classical 'follow→spread' etymon; and whether every nominal occurrence carries the allegiance/individuation load distinct from a generic جماعة.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude dictionary/lexicon/tafsir etymology and morphology-family inference as authority; require actual shared co-text or syntactic demonstration, not gloss overlap ('same gloss ≠ synonymy', 'morphology ≠ semantic identity').
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the verb is shown to share the nominal nucleus, strength rises toward STRONG and scope toward a fuller ROOT_GENERALIZATION; if the nominal invariant fractures, drop to UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY and abandon the single nominal nucleus.

reopen_conditions: If a further Quranic occurrence of the verb تشيع (or any other ش ي ع verbal form) appears with a human/collective subject or in a grouping frame, re-test whether the verb and the nominal 'aligned bloc' sense share one nucleus — potentially lifting 24:19 out of RESISTANT and raising strength toward STRONG.

If re-examination shows the أَشْيَاع occurrences (34:54, 54:51) mean strictly 'likes/kind' with no allegiance/course component, split N3 from N1/N2 and re-grade the nominal nucleus as narrower than 'aligned bloc'.

If the شِيَعًا↔فَرَّق fragmentation pattern (6:159, 30:32, 28:4, 6:65) is shown to be a distinct lexicalized 'schism' sense not reducible to the neutral 'side/party' of 28:15/37:83, partition the nouns into separate classes rather than one valence-neutral invariant.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The nominal nucleus survives adversarial pressure across all 11 nominal occurrences with a distinctive allegiance/individuation load (28:15 antonymy; حِزْب/طَආئِفَة contrast). However one occurrence (24:19, verb) genuinely resists and its bridge is not independently establishable, so a clean SUPPORTED/PASSED verdict with empty failing_occurrences is not available; recorded as NOT_RUN with the resistant token logged rather than claimed PASSED.
